info.title: Z3rno Memory API
info.description: AI Agent Memory Database — store, recall, forget, audit

get.description: Liveness probe — returns 200 if the process is running.
Readiness probe — checks database and Valkey connectivity.

post.description: Store a new memory with optional embedding, relationships, and TTL.
Recall memories using vector similarity, filters, and temporal queries.
Soft or hard delete memories with optional cascade.

post.summary: Store multiple memories in a single request
post.description: Store multiple memories atomically in a single transaction.

get.summary: Get a single memory by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single memory by its UUID.

patch.description: Update a memory's content, metadata, or importance score.

get.summary: Get temporal history of a memory
get.description: Return all temporal versions of a memory (SCD Type 2 history).
Query the audit log with filters and pagination.

post.description: Start a new session. Stores session state in Valkey with 24h TTL.
End a session. Transitions working memories tagged with this session to episodic.

get.description: Get the current state of a session from Valkey.

get.summary: List API keys for the authenticated org
get.description:
List all API keys for the authenticated organization.

Never returns the key itself — only id, name, prefix, and timestamps.

schema.title: Response List Api Keys V1 Api Keys Get

post.description:
Create a new API key for the authenticated organization.

The full key is returned only once in this response. It cannot be
retrieved again — only the prefix is stored.

delete.description:
Revoke an API key by setting revoked_at = now().

Returns 204 No Content on success, 404 if the key doesn't exist
or doesn't belong to the authenticated org.

get.description:
Check Celery worker health by dispatching a ping task.

Returns 200 if a worker responds within 5 seconds, 503 otherwise.

ApiKeyListItem.title: ApiKeyListItem
ApiKeyListItem.description: A single API key in the list response (never includes the key itself).

CreateApiKeyResponse.title: CreateApiKeyResponse
CreateApiKeyResponse.description: Response for creating a new API key (only time the full key is visible).
